title: Why do American generals keep visiting these tiny islands?

questions why do American generals keep visiting these tiny islands and why park missiles in a province where people still pay for their groceries on the honor system  so the province is called Batanes and the answer starts with a map Batanes is the northernmost tip of the Philippines and that undersells it its last islet Mabulis sits about 140 kilometers from Taiwan and the capital Basco is different hardware presence is sovereignty and sovereignty is whatever you can keep a human being standing on but the real reason is less sentimental America is not fortifying butanase to defend butanase nor even strictly speaking to defend the Philippines  in a Taiwan war the Luzon Strait decides whether the conflict stays in one sea or spills into all of them and Batanes is the only land in
